programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.sub-title: Lovett or Leave It (50 Year Wave)
programme.desc: Republicans try to keep their heads above water as that big Blue Wave crashes over America, baby. Meanwhile, Trump ignores the beam in his own eye, and the White House stocks up on frozen baby mice to feed new Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. On the show, New York City Councilman Chi Osse and Heather McGhee talk firsts, (hopefully) lasts, and I told you sos from the 2026 midterms, while Brad Lander rolls up his sleeves and digs into Democrats’ new priorities in Congress. The Rant Wheel spins and Lovett sprints, off the stage and into the crowd, to lib out with our incredible Crooked Con audience.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.sub-title: Pod Save America (Will Dems Chuck Chuck?)
programme.desc: Description: As Democrats debate who’s best to lead Congress in the next session, Donald Trump installs his most loyal aide as chief of staff and tries to cope with his dramatic midterms losses. Jon and Dan discuss the arguments for and against Chuck Schumer becoming Majority Leader, how Trump will spend his final two years in office with an enabling Stephen Miller by his side, and whether JD Vance can chameleon into an anti-establishment politician in order to win the GOP nomination for president. They also cover Scott Colom’s win in Mississippi and the shocking scandal that toppled Trump friend and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, and the massive global ramifications that may follow.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.sub-title: What a Day (Colom Reminds Dems, Mississippi Matters)
programme.desc: Mississippi has a Black Democratic Senator! Democratic nominee Scott Colom defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith this week in Mississippi's closely contested U.S. Senate race, giving the state its first Black U.S. senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction. To talk about Senator-elect Colom’s historic victory and what it took to get here, Jane speaks with Charles Taylor, Executive Director of the Mississippi State Conference of the NAACP.

programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner
programme.sub-title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner (How the Hell Did Democrats Win In Mississippi?)
programme.desc: Mississippi just elected a Democrat to the US Senate for the first time since 1982—their first Black senator since Reconstruction. How did Scott Colom win such an underfunded and under-discussed race in one of the reddest states in the country? His meaty media strategy played a big role. Alex sits down with the creator of Colom’s viral “Pick Another Protein” ad, Ryan Sayles, to get the backstory on how the video came to be, why he thinks it’s a national sensation, and why Colom is barely in it. Then she’s joined by some of the most powerful communicators in the game—influencer Carlos Eduardo Espina, No Lie’s Brian Tyler Cohen, Fox News’s Jessica Tarlov, and I’ve Had It host Jennifer Welch—to get into the myriad ways that Democrats broke through the noise this cycle and convinced voters to make a change.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.sub-title: What a Day (White House Threatens Congressional Oversight)
programme.desc: The White House counsel sent a letter to California Democratic Rep. Robert Garcia, threatening him for demanding to perform oversight. This comes after a Saturday Truth Social post in which President Donald Trump said he was ordering the Justice Department to look into Democrats’ investigation threats. On today’s show, Jane speaks with Jake Sherman, founder of Punchbowl News, about the priority shifts in Congress following the blue tsunami.

programme.sub-title: Blood Trails | S2 E3 | The Search for Bob Smith | Blood Trails S2 E2
programme.desc: Bob Smith stepped into the Maine woods on a November afternoon in 1997 and never came back. His wife heard a single gunshot. Then... nothing. What followed was the largest ground search in the history of the Maine Warden Service. Investigators found clues—a set of boot prints, a strange arrow in the dirt, even a dead moose nearby—but none of them led to Bob. As the search dragged on, rumors surfaced: out-of-state hunters who left early, a story about an accidental shooting, and people who may have known more than they said. Was Bob Smith the victim of a tragic accident… or something far more deliberate? Want more Blood Trails? programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.desc: Steven Rinella and friend Cody Lujan head to Northeastern New Mexico to hunt pronghorn antelope, the fastest big game animal in the United States. In the wide open desert plains, Steve will have to work hard to stalk within range of a mature buck. The payoff will be antelope loin topped with local New Mexico chiles.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Primal Cuts: Bone-in Cooking Special
programme.desc: In this cooking special, Steven Rinella shows his fans some of his favorite preparations for big, bone-in cuts of red meat. Interspersed with highlights from his recent caribou, buffalo, and mule deer hunts, the show features recipes that utilize some of the most underappreciated parts of big game animals. This episode is an attractive and delicious tribute to Steve's gun-to-table ethic.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, Mexico to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season. Steve sets up camp and spends days glassing mountains and canyons for these elusive, wary desert whitetails. Meanwhile, his hunting partner, Remi Warren, attempts the difficult task of stalking one with a bow. To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Clash of the Titans: Northern California Pig & Deer
programme.desc: In this episode, Steven Rinella joins forces with fellow hunter and wild game chef Hank Shaw in the hills of Central California to go after Columbia blacktail deer, wild pigs, and a handful of small game species that are in season. The end result is a culinary smorgasbord of epic proportions.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Sea Bear: Alaska Spring Bear and Seafood
programme.desc: Steve ventures out to his hunting and fishing shack on a remote coastline of southeast Alaska's Prince of Wales Island. While hunting bears from a skiff and a canoe, Steve gathers a variety of prime seafood and makes a discovery about his own motivations as a bear hunter.

programme.title: MeatEater
programme.sub-title: MeatEater - Full Boar: Whole Hog Cooking Special
programme.desc: Steven Rinella breaks down an entire boar and shares some of his favorite recipes in this Cooking Special. Matt Weingarter helps steve make head cheese, pork skin cracklins, smoked pork butt, and a tied-roast boned-out ham. Each dish requires thoughtful butchering, processing, and cooking to execute to perfection.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Talk Show and Variety

programme.title: Sencillamente Maity Interiano
programme.sub-title: Amara La Negra: Perdonar y sanar
programme.desc: Vivió en su carro. Creció con heridas profundas. Y aun así, eligió perdonar. En esta entrevista, la actriz y presentadora Amara La Negra abre su corazón como pocas veces: su dura infancia.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Lissette Engel denuncia que el gobierno ha permitido al IRS compartir con ICE información de personas indocumentadas que declaran impuestos usando un ITIN. A pesar del miedo a las deportaciones.

programme.title: Sencillamente Maity Interiano
programme.sub-title: Jacky Bracamontes: El dolor de madre
programme.desc: Hay conversaciones que te marcan… y esta es una de ellas. En este episodio de Sencillamente Maity Interiano, me siento con Jacky Bracamontes para hablar sobre lo que realmente importa: el matrimonio.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Ezequiel Hernández expone que las agencias federales han comenzado a derivar casos de asilo pendientes a cortes de deportación con un alto índice de negación de fianzas.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Nicolás Ibarguen relata cómo los hipopótamos llevados por Pablo Escobar se tornaron en una especie invasora que pone en grave riesgo al ecosistema de Colombia. Para detener su sacrificio.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Fernanda Echavarri esclarece cómo el fútbol soccer aterrizó primero en Estados Unidos que en América Latina, siendo luego superado drásticamente por el fútbol americano.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Guadalupe Loaeza asegura que México sigue sumido en el mismo clasismo y desigualdad de hace cuarenta años, situación ahora adoptada por las élites del movimiento 4T.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Ninoska Pérez acoge con emoción la imputación legal contra Raúl Castro, autor de la orden de derribar aeronaves civiles en espacio aéreo internacional en 1996.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Niña Pastori habla sobre su álbum "Color Fania", valorando el esfuerzo técnico de versionar piezas de salsa con su característica identidad vocal flamenca. En otro ámbito.
